content.comment_body: Hello, I'm facing the same issue. I got a new, unopened operator device panel, but it's an older model from 2017, and the enter button doesn't respond. So far, I haven't found any solution.
Hi, have you managed to resolve this issue?

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports that the enter button does not work on a newly purchased but older operator device panel from 2017, even though the device is unused. Other forum members have not suggested any fixes, and there are no official solutions mentioned. This raises concerns about the reliability and usability of products stored for long periods before use.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect all buttons, especially the enter key, on a new operator device panel to be fully functional, regardless of its manufacturing year.
